branding.greeting: Welcome to Fresh Fade Studio. I can check hours, quote prices, or get you booked. What do you need?

policies.walkins: Walk-ins welcome, but appointments get priority. Saturdays fill up fast.
policies.cancellation: Free to cancel or reschedule up to 2 hours before your appointment.
policies.late: More than 15 minutes late and we may need to reschedule you.
policies.deposit: No deposit for standard cuts. Group bookings of 3 or more need a $20 deposit.
policies.payment: Cash, card, Cash App, Apple Pay and Zelle.
policies.kids: Kids 12 and under are $20. We're patient with first-timers.
policies.guarantee: Not happy with your cut? Come back within 7 days and we'll fix it free.

faqs.a: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. Appointments get priority though, and Saturdays fill up fast, so booking ahead is safer.
Walk-in waits are usually 15–30 minutes on weekdays and can hit an hour on Saturdays. Booking skips the line.
We do tapers, fades, and pixie shapes for anyone. For color, long-layer cuts or styling, our salon side handles that.
Yes — pomades, beard oil, brushes and durags in-shop. Most items run $12–$28.
